fields.title: Proteomics analysis of cellular nucleic acid binding proteins
fields.description: Organic solvents and Ti4+-IMAC capture of formaldehyde (FA) cross-linked cells followed by mass spectrometry analysis to identify nucleic acid binding proteins in human cells.
fields.sample_protocol: Cells were washed two times with PBS and cross-linked by formaldehyde, then lysate by TRIZOL regent. Organic solvent was used to precipitate NAs-protein complex crude, and Ti4+-IMAC was used to capture NAs-protein complex. Proteins were de-cross-linked from NAs-protein complexes by heat at 65 °C for 6 h. Then digested by using Filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) approach. Proteins obtained from formaldehyde cross-linking and Organic solvent extraction optimized process was analyzed by Easy-nLC 1000 coupled with an LTQ Orbitrap XL mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).  Proteins obtained from method comparation (293T total cell lysate, organic solvent extraction, Ti4+-IMAC capture) and method application (95C, 95D, total cell lysate and Ti4+-IMAC capture) were analyzed by Easy-nanoLC1000 coupled with an Obitrap Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA).
